system: M = 3 quantum dots without interdot hopping, Fig. 3(b) of the manuscript
units: energies in units of gamma, the full level width of each dot (gamma = 2 pi V^2 rho_0); flat conduction band of half-width D = gamma / gamma_over_D
note: record of the production settings; ../scripts/01_run_nrg_tqd.py has the same values as its defaults (see cluster_run.md)

model.leads: each dot coupled to its own reservoir, Gamma = gamma * identity; interaction U_i n_i,up n_i,dn + U_ij n_i n_j for all pairs

nrg_spectra.comment: spectra at v = v_over_gamma; nshells = ceil(2 ln(0.5 / (1e-3 T/D)) / ln Lambda) + 2 = 19
nrg_spectra.thermal_window: log bins below omega0 = T broadened with a linear Gaussian of width T

nrg_occupation_sweep.comment: occupations n_i(v) for panel (b); one z shift, no spectra
